title: Physiological Phenotyping of Respiratory Outcomes in Infants Born Premature
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine if infants are more likely to suffer from respiratory complications during their first year of life due to being born premature.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants born to mothers who are between the gestational ages of 24+0 and 36+6 weeks.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cardiopulmonary defects
* Chromosomal defects
* Structural abnormalities of the upper airway, chest wall, or lungs
* Neurological/Neuromuscular disorders
* Infant not considered viable
* Family unlikely to be available for long term follow up
* Mothers under the age of 18.
* Non English speaking
study_population: Recruiting infants born between 24+0 and 36+6 weeks gestational age
